sources.title: Edit your Business Profile
claims: A Business Profile can include a full website URL and Googlebot should not be blocked from the site.

sources.title: Get started with Search Console
claims: Search Console reports how Google crawls, indexes, and serves websites, and URL Inspection shows current index status and live testing options.

sources.title: Manage customer reviews
claims: Google provides guidance for managing and replying to Business Profile reviews.

editorialNotes: The article is a practical documentation checklist with no external numeric, ranking, traffic, customer, or location claims.
Google product behavior claims are linked to current primary documentation.
Quarterly review is framed as a practical recommendation, not a Google requirement.
